BILL NUMBER:  S5467

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the highway law, in relation to designating a portion
of the state highway system in the village of Holland Patent as the
"Marine Lance Cpl. Blaise Oleski Memorial Highway"


 PURPOSE :
This bill designates a portion of State Route 365 in the village of
Holland Patent as the Marine Lance Cpl. Blaise Oleski Memorial
Highway.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
This act designates all that portion of the state highway system in
the village of Holland Patent constituting State Route 365 from the
west village line of Holland Patent (Reference Marker 12C 2601 2117)
to the east village line of Holland Patent (Reference Marker 12C 2601
2121) as the "Marine Lance Cpl. Blaise Oleski Memorial Highway". This
designation is one of a ceremonial nature and the official name of
such highway shall not be changed as a result of this act.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Marine Lance Cpl. Blaise Oleski, age 22 and a resident of the Town of
Floyd, Oneida County was killed in action on April 8, 2009 while
supporting combat operations Now Zad, Afghanistan. A marine infantry
assaultman, Lance Cpl. Blaise Ole ski was assigned to 3rd Battalion,
8th Marine Regiment, 2nd Marine Division, II Marine Expeditionary
Force, based at Camp Lejeune, North Carolina. Marine Lance Cpl.
Blaise Oleski was a 2004 graduate of Holland Patent High School and
enlisted in the Marine Corps in May 2006. It is only fitting that
Marine Lance Cpl. Blaise Oleski, who made the ultimate sacrifice for
his country, be honored by designating the portion of State Highway
Route 365 in the Village of Holland Patent the Marine Lance Cpl.
Blaise Oleski Memorial Highway.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
No impact on local governments, impact to the state would be minimal
for signage.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediate.
